briefs.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, leading to an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G was installed.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple international public health organizations, scientific bodies, and fact-checking outlets report that 5G mobile networks do not transmit or accelerate the spread of COVID-19. On 2020-02-27, the World Health Organization reported no causal link between wireless technology exposure and adverse health effects. The International Telecommunication Union stated on 2020-04-22 that 5G has no technical link to spreading the virus. Fact-checkers including AP News and AFP Fact Check examined claims comparing 5G installation maps with COVID-19 cases in April 2020 and rated them False, noting that the virus spreads via respiratory droplets and had actively spread in areas with no 5G networks. Further fact checks by The Quint and Alt News in April and May 2021 found no connection between 5G testing and case surges in India.
